_meta.purpose: K-series heads, blocks and stock internals for the K20Z3 simulator (head and block are separate selectable parts).
_meta.rule: Every number was read on a fetched page listed in its 'sources'. null = not found. Nothing estimated. Aggregator/forum-only figures are labelled.
_meta.sourceQuality: Primary: hondanews.com spec sheets, Honda Japan factbooks (honda.co.jp), Honda fact sheet PDF, hondapartsnow/acurapartswarehouse catalogues. Parts makers: Wiseco, CP, Manley, Eagle, SpeedFactory, Brian Crower, King, ACL, Supertech, Hybrid Racing, 4 Piston, PRL, Drag Cartel, KPower. Secondary: Wikipedia (many ratings/rev limits are Wikipedia-only and flagged), 8020automotive, MotoIQ, EngineLabs. Aggregator (low confidence): motorreviewer.com cam/valve numbers.
_meta.blocked: k20a.org (stock cam specs thread), clubrsx.com, heeltoeauto (robots), hondapartsnow CR-V pages failed; curl to honda.co.jp blocked (WebFetch worked).
_meta.headCodeNote: The codes PRB/PRC/RBC/RRC/RBB/PNC/RSP in Wikipedia's tables are INTAKE MANIFOLD codes. OEM bare cylinder head part numbers found: PRB (12100-PRB-A00), K20A3 (12100-PNC-010), K20Z3 (12100-RBC-000), K24A2 (12100-RBB-000), K24A4 (12100-RAA-A01), K24Z3/Z7 (12100-R40-A02). Casting numbers on the heads themselves were not found.
_meta.derivedConsistencyCheck: Not a sourced figure: deck = stroke/2 + rod + compression height gives 43+139+30 = 212 (K20) and 49.5+152+30 = 231.5 (K24), consistent with the sourced values.
